notes: The "24HB" model (24" screen, 1000-NIT High-Bright variant, part number PROP-24HB) is a monitor in Prompter People's ProLine Plus talent-monitor/prompter line. A dedicated per-model spec page for "24HB" alone was not found; port data comes from the manufacturer's ProLine Plus widescreen series page, which states the same connector set is identical across all screen sizes (13.3"-24") and across both standard (400 NIT) and High-Bright (1000 NIT) variants: "3G-SDI in | 3G-SDI out | HDMI in | VGA | Composite" plus "4-Pin XLR Locking Power Side Input." Cross-checked against Markertek's listing for the companion kit PROP-24HB-24TM, which independently confirms "3G-SDI, HDMI, composite, and VGA inputs" and "XLR power supply included." Composite video is carried on a BNC connector per the manufacturer page's connector shorthand ("...VGA | BNC..."). Power connector is a locking 4-pin XLR carrying DC from an included external AC adapter (battery-operable), mapped to xlr4-dc per the DC-power convention, not the xlr4 audio convention. No HDMI/SDI cable-length or exact resolution/version (e.g. 1080p vs 4K, HDMI 1.4 vs 2.0) was stated, so no grade is set for the HDMI port. Unit is tripod/stand-mounted, not rack-mountable, so rackUnits is omitted. No USB/RS-232/network control port was documented on the monitor itself (the bundled TeleScroll/Flip-Q prompting software runs on an external PC/Mac, not the monitor).
